definitions.complex_fundamental: 2/N times first rFFT coefficient after removing the temporal mean over the first cycle
definitions.equal_active_power_scale: g=sqrt(P_A1/P_S1), applied to the S1 linear complex response; g^2 P_S1=P_A1 algebraically
definitions.interpolation: piecewise-linear interpolation of real and imaginary complex coefficients separately; exact_native_node is also reported
definitions.near_zero_rule: ratios are omitted when the denominator is at or below the amplitude floor; phase is omitted when response or activation amplitude is at or below the floor
definitions.weights: trapezoidal nodal quadrature on the full x/L interval; endpoints receive half adjacent spacing and interior nodes half the sum of adjacent spacings
